description: This file contains implementations and declarations related to BLAS (Basic Linear Algebra Subprograms) operations, including dot products, matrix-vector multiplication (gemv), and related utilities, with platform-specific optimizations and external C BLAS function calls.

methods.name: remove_const
methods.description: Template function to cast away constness from a pointer, used internally for API calls that are not const-correct.

methods.name: fp16_gemv_trans
methods.description: Dispatches to platform-specific or optimized implementation of FP16 GEMV (matrix-vector multiplication) with transposed matrix.

methods.name: fp16_dot
methods.description: Calculates dot product for FP16 data type using optimized stub.

methods.name: bf16_dot
methods.description: Calculates dot product for BF16 data type using optimized stub.

methods.name: scal
methods.description: Scales a vector by a scalar, with platform-specific fast path optimization.

methods.name: gemv
methods.description: Performs matrix-vector multiplication with optional transposition, utilizing platform-specific fast paths when available.

methods.name: dot_impl_floating
methods.description: Implements dot product for floating point types, choosing between BLAS fast path and naive implementation.

methods.name: dot_impl
methods.description: General dot product implementation that dispatches to specialized floating point or complex implementations.

methods.name: vdot_impl
methods.description: Implements vector dot product, including conjugation for complex types, with platform-specific optimizations.
